topic: Ground support equipment classification and colour coding, servicing/ records, testing / calibration of GSE, gauges and aircraft lifting/ restraint
syllabus_extract: Ground support equipment classification and colour coding, servicing/ records, testing / calibration of GSE, gauges and aircraft lifting/ restraint equipment.
specific_objectives: 1.1.3.2 Trainee will be able to describe tool control, checks on ground support equipment for various operations.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of GSE colour coding identification, inspection of servicing records, and verification of gauge calibration tags under instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of Ground Support Equipment (GSE)?
Why is colour coding essential for GSE identification?
What are the consequences of using uncalibrated gauges on aircraft?

development.content:
GSE Classification Categories
Colour Coding Standards
Servicing and Record Keeping
Testing and Calibration Procedures

Aircraft Lifting Equipment Safety
Restraint Equipment Usage
Tool Control Procedures
Inspection Checklists

Gauge Calibration Verification
Defect Reporting Protocols
Maintenance Log Entries
Final Operational Checks

summary_questions: Explain the significance of specific colour codes for different GSE categories.
Describe the steps required to verify the calibration status of a hydraulic gauge.
How should a defect in lifting equipment be documented and reported?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the organizational functions of NAY(K) and NAQAS as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 16), focusing on their role in GSE maintenance oversight.

pft_rows.syllabus: Organizations and function of NAY (K) / NAY(G), NAQAS, NASDO, AAEHU, INDA(K) MO(K/G), CNAMS.
